title: Fusion 1: Nodes, Viewers, and Image Flow

video.note: General page workflow, a separate Fusion practice timeline, clip-level composition, viewers, connections, Blur and Color Corrector examples. Students build a simple node chain first.
video.source: Casey Faris / Ground Control: Introduction to DaVinci Resolve

learningTarget: I can build and explain a simple MediaIn-to-effect-to-MediaOut node flow and verify the result on the Edit page.

bellRinger.prompt: If a picture passes through a blur before reaching the screen, what would each step in that flowchart do?

vocabulary.definition: A tool or image source represented as a box in a Fusion flow.
An image entering the Fusion composition from timeline or media sources.
The final image sent back to the timeline.
A link carrying an image or mask between nodes.
A panel that can display the output of a selected node.
Temporarily disabling a tool to compare the result with the original.

slides.title: Fusion 1: Nodes, Viewers, and Image Flow

assignment.title: Fusion Image-Flow Checkpoint
evidenceRequired: A Google Docs or Drive link with a Fusion screenshot showing MediaIn, one effect, MediaOut, and the output viewer.
In the same document, explain the three nodes and include an enabled/bypassed comparison or paired screenshots.
A 2-3 sentence DCC reflection explaining how image flow and node viewers helped you find or prevent an error.
assignment.reflectionPrompt: In 2-3 sentences, trace your image through the three nodes and explain how the viewers helped you check the result.

exitTicket: Trace your image from MediaIn to MediaOut and explain what your effect node changes.
